reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 8 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Pacers.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Cavaliers win 69 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 206 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: Indiana lost in Houston with Rick Carlisle ejected for the first time this season, Andrew Nembhard missing a second game with a sore hip and Tyrese Haliburton still out; the front office is shopping for wing upgrades, which can unsettle the names in the rumours. Cleveland are without Evan Mobley for at least another week and lost at home to Memphis. The angle leans mildly towards Cleveland.
